description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Master Transmuter by paying {U}, tapping it and returning Gilded Lotus from the battlefield to your hand, putting Gilded Lotus onto the battlefield.
When Gilded Lotus enters, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, as Gilded Lotus is a land due to Toph, untapping Master Transmuter.
Repeat.
